subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should watched-session information be exposed only through an operator-read-scoped/redacted presence projection, with pairing and node recipients receiving no raw session identifiers?
rationale: The PR introduces a shared-gateway visibility contract that affects existing authorization boundaries; the correct long-term shape must be chosen by the feature owner rather than inferred from a UI need.

options.title: Use read-scoped viewer projection
options.body: Expose session viewer data only to recipients authorized to read the relevant session, and omit or redact it for pairing and node recipients.

options.title: Publish sanitized aggregate presence
options.body: Keep generic presence broadly visible but expose only a non-identifying aggregate that cannot reveal session, channel, agent, or peer identifiers.

options.title: Pause viewer presence
options.body: Keep the identity prerequisite and defer watched-session facepiles until the gateway privacy contract is specified.

recommendation.title: Use read-scoped viewer projection
recommendation.body: Expose session viewer data only to recipients authorized to read the relevant session, and omit or redact it for pairing and node recipients.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the current PR and the merged identity-presence prerequisite within the linked identity program.
